gameplay:
Create a finished game UI visual, ONE SINGLE EXACTLY SQUARE SCREEN, not a collage, not a presentation board. The image fills a 1:1 square edge-to-edge. Treat the underlying device as exactly 240×240 pixels and enlarge every original pixel by the same integer factor, ideally deliver 960×960. No perspective, no device casing, no outer margin, no captions outside the square. Use genuine coarse 8-bit/16-bit ARCADE PIXEL ART suitable for this tiny resolution: 2px blocky outlines, stepped corners, readable pixel Chinese text, flat 12-color palette, crisp square pixels. No glossy gradients, no smooth vectors, no fine illustration, no tiny pseudo-text.

Game: 贪吃腊肠, a 3-stage single-button clockwise-turn Snake game. NO other games. New art direction: bright inviting retro arcade, NOT the provisional black/CRT/moss-green background. Color system: warm ivory #FFF2D5 main canvas, deep ink-indigo #283454 outlines/text, coral-red #E66A50 for titles/selection, golden yellow #F7C94B reward accents, muted turquoise #62B7A5 minor accent, pale butter #F9E2A0 and pale apricot #F6D4AD for subtle fields, brown #B77740 and #794B35 dog, cream-white bones. Highly readable contrasting selected states. Evoke a charming 1980s tabletop arcade score display through block lettering, graphic flags, little starbursts, stepped frames, checker trim ONLY in small UI header/footer regions. No neon glow, no dark background, no flowers, forests or garden illustration. Keep decoration purposeful and restrained, the small screen must still feel usable.

Context character where shown: one small brown side-profile dachshund with a long thin body following snake-grid cells, one head at the leading end, one tail at the other, exactly four little feet, front pair near head rear pair near tail. Not a regular green snake, not multiple heads, no elaborate animal illustration. Tiny cream bone food; simple slate rock obstacles where stage≥2.
Physical keys are A selection/pause, B confirm/clockwise turn, C return. Do not add a D-pad, joystick, touch steering, hearts/health, timers, upgrades, shops or new mechanics. Every stage needs5 bones; max15 across3 stages. Rewards 0/1/2/3 stars = shells5/10/20/30. Show shell not generic coin, do not show spirit stat.

THIS SCREEN: ACTIVE GAMEPLAY, stage2. Rebuild for the 240×240 square, not a wide frame squashed to square. Reserve the complete 200×200 game board at x20,y30 to x220,y230, exactly 10×10 cells each20px. Use pale ivory/butter checker tiles with VERY subtle contrast; thin indigo outline; no large decorations inside board. At the top y6–24 a compact scoreboard ribbon: coral little stage badge "02", cream bone icon and "3/5" in center, small trophy with "11" on right. Keep header thin, no title crowding board. The active dog runs along an L-shaped path near center with head facing right, exactly one head and four legs only, small coral next-direction arrow immediately ahead. Two small obstacle segments each3 slate tiles, one vertical left and one horizontal near bottom-right. One bone food in a free cell. The gameplay area dominates, no modal, no bottom toolbar, no instruction sentences. A thin stepped arcade border around entire square, restrained tiny corner ticks. Finished professional pixel UI, little graphic polish beyond the crude simulator. Numbers and bone icon must be readable at240px. Full-screen square image ONLY.
